title: Law Firm Case Management
description: Clients, matters, deadlines and time entries for a small law firm.
forWho: Small law firms and solo attorneys

spec.useCase: Hollis Brandt manages the office of a four-person law firm and uses this to see every open matter, which deadlines fall today or this week, and how many hours have been logged on each file. Operational tracking only; it holds no legal advice.

question.ask: How many deadlines are still open?
question.whyItMatters: The office manager reviews open deadlines with the partners every Monday.

text.text: Your firm in one place. Start with Deadlines due today and this week, move through Matters by status, and log hours under Time entries. This is operational tracking only; keep legal work product, advice and privileged notes in your case files.
Same steps every time, so nothing is skipped.
Add the person under Clients as a Prospect.
Run the conflict check and note the result on the client.
Send the engagement letter and wait for the signature.
Press Open matter on the client and assign an attorney and paralegal.
Add every known deadline using Add deadline.
Set the matter to Open once the retainer is in.
A missed deadline is the most expensive mistake in a law office. Record each in two places.
State where it comes from, such as a rule, an order or a client promise.
Enter it in this table and on the firm calendar.
Open Deadlines, Overdue view, every Monday.
Review This week with each attorney.
Mark Done only after the filing confirmation is saved.
Log time at the end of every task, not the end of the week.
Write a short description a client would understand.
Look at Time entries not billed and tell the office manager.
Check hours against each matter's budget.
Final time entries recorded and billed
File archived and retention date noted
